sv.title: Uppgifter: Zlatan får skurkroll i brittisk gangsterserie
sv.summary: Den tidigare landslagskaptenen uppges ha fått en roll i den tredje säsongen av Paramount+ kriminalserie Mobland. Serien porträtterar rivaliserande gangsterfamiljer i London.

en.title: Reports: Zlatan gets villain role in British gangster series
en.summary: The former national team captain is reportedly cast in the third season of the Paramount+ crime series Mobland. The series portrays rival gangster families in London.
